j.desc: Bell-bearing Spanish colonial soldier in early1500s river scene. Adult man about thirty-five, sun-weathered olive skin, short dark hair under plain rounded steel helmet, dark mustache and brief neat beard, stern fatigued face. Simple worn steel breastplate over brown padded sleeves, dark knee breeches, brown hose/boots; historically evocative plain gear, no modern insignia. Full-body three-quarter standing. Both hands visible naturally holding a long wooden pole upright beside body, small brass bell suspended from pole top. Bell and both boots fully contained with margins. No torch, no drawn weapon, no background, no hatching.
